text_en: My goodness, it's hot! An old Kobold like me simply melts in this climate. I can't stop panting.
Is that you, tin man? Of course it is.
You've arrived just as I was leaving, so I can't accompany you beyond this point. I don't think I'll be back in the desert, unless I bring my caravan.
Luckily for you, I've sketched out the route that I took on my way here. You can take a look in my shop, yes? Perhaps we've travelled different paths.
